identification: Victorian carved medallion (cameo) back double-ended settee, c1860-80, walnut or mahogany (colour reads as walnut). Pierced C-scroll and leaf carved crest over a buttoned oval back with carved pierced side frets, rolled buttoned arms at both ends with carved scroll arm terminals, serpentine seat rail with carved centre, cabriole front legs on castors. Recently reupholstered in beige damask. L190. Estimate $250-400, current bid $150 (27 Nov).

viewing_check: Lift it and check the underside: timber (walnut vs mahogany), webbing and springs, frame joints and any wobble. Look for carving losses or glued repairs on the crest and side frets, check the castors are original and roll, and check the new upholstery is well done (tacks, piping).
